answer.rationale: memory_73 (targeted promotional pricing for SMBs) is weakly supported for sustainable long-term qualified revenue because it reports acquisition and revenue lift but explicitly omits retention impact and long-term value metrics. Promotional pricing often creates short-term gain at the expense of long-term cohort quality and unit economics. memory_44 (enterprise sales-assisted flows) is most strongly supported because enterprise deals inherently deliver higher contract values and longer retention horizons, directly supporting sustainable revenue. memory_86, memory_91, and memory_31 are well-supported as they improve activation and onboarding—foundational to retention and LTV. memory_57 (referral incentives in established customers) is moderately supported because it leverages existing, retained cohorts and adds revenue through warm channels, but lacks detail on long-term incentive costs or margin impact.
